brief: A display stand with the large platform on a spike where three bases meet.

requirements.requirement: Display stand with three bases meeting at one junction
requirements.evidence: Placed piece:0,0,0;full + piece:0,1,0;full + piece:1,0,0;full — all surround junction [0,0|0,1|1,0] creating a three-base cluster.

requirements.requirement: Large platform on a spike at that junction
requirements.evidence: Added spike:0#0,0|0,1|1,0 at level 0, converted to variant mount, set accessory platform-lrg — large circular display platform centered where the three bases meet.

finish.summary: Built a triangular display stand: three full hex bases at (0,0), (0,1) and (1,0) locked with joint bolts and capped, with a mount spike at their shared junction carrying the large platform (platform-lrg) as a raised display surface.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
